g.text: A different estimator under the same periodic access

text.style: font-size: 10.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24303e

g.text: Descriptive benchmark: the anchor filter estimates state, ordinary bias, and reference bias; both receive six references.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24303e

g.text: Each world: 2,000 held-out seeds. Whiskers: descriptive 95% intervals. Dashed line: nominal 90% coverage.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24303e

g.text: Hidden forcing is a constant ±0.15 input; reference bias is a constant ±0.25 offset. All estimators assume zero forcing.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #24303e

g.text: Estimator and uncertainty model both change here. Differences cannot be attributed solely to when references are acquired.
